about: Personal storylines the server makes (Docs/Design/58-player-storytellers.md, 3): from ties (doc 52: tie-<starter> with a resident, tie-<starter>-mentor with a mentor), residents' troubles (doc 57: trouble-<kind>), contract chains (chain) and the Dungeon Master (the-debt, a-gathering). Roles in braces are filled from the cast: {tie}, {keeper}, {resident}, {poster} (ids), {square}, {place} (cells). [[id]] shows as the reader knows that wolf. A step's marker names a role (a resident's work place, a place's middle); its brief is one line for that resident's Mind while the step is current. 3 to 7 steps; the first is ticked at once.

steps.title: You arrive
steps.text: You have come to a new town, and someone here is tied to you.

steps.title: Find [[{tie}]]
steps.text: They work in town; ask after them, or look where they work.
steps.brief: This wolf is the newcomer you're tied to: You came into town on the same cart; they remember you.

steps.title: See the town
steps.text: Walk to the market square and take in the place.

steps.title: Talk about the road you shared
steps.text: Go back to [[{tie}]] and talk it over.
steps.brief: This wolf, tied to you (you came into town on the same cart; they remember you), has come back to talk it over.

objectives.line: Talk about the road you shared
